verdict.rationale: Docs name several supported stablecoins (USDP, PYUSD, USDC, USDG, PAXG) and note PYUSD is available on 'multiple blockchains,' but USDT is never mentioned, and no concrete per-chain breakdown (e.g., Ethereum, Solana, Tron) is given for any coin. missing for 10: USDT support confirmation, explicit named-chain list per stablecoin, and any comparison table matching stablecoin-to-chain.
